status: secondary robustness; NOT confirmatory, NOT the primary 24-cell replication family
frozen_before: any augmented-Z evaluator result (ConditionalG2, gap, or decomposition quantity)

augmented_z.z_primary: z_key_exact (exact seven-label human-annotation vector, frozen order)
augmented_z.length_measure: len(comment_text) character count of the raw stored comment text
augmented_z.length_threshold_rule: median character length over the frozen 69,573-row primary manifest, A-blind and evaluator-independent; analysis recomputes and asserts M==225
augmented_z.L_rule: L = 1 iff length > M else 0 (ties at M -> 0)
augmented_z.outcome_blind: L uses only comment character length; never A, Z human labels, evaluator scores, or identity attributes

inferential_test.multiplicity: Holm across all 24 augmented-Z raw permutation p-values, alpha 0.05
inferential_test.informative_stratum_rule: size>=2 and both A present; single-A/degenerate strata dropped, as in primary
inferential_test.family_note: separate robustness family from the primary 24; no post-hoc subfamilies

common_support_decomposition.type: descriptive only; NO p-values, permutation tests, confidence intervals, or new multiplicity
common_support_decomposition.gap_definition: stratum-size-weighted conditional mean difference mean(S|A=1)-mean(S|A=0) over informative strata (weighted_mean_gap), 1-5 scale
common_support_decomposition.primary_gap: already-frozen primary-Z gap from results/civil_comments/llm_audit_results.json weighted_mean_gap_1to5; analysis asserts recomputation equals frozen value
common_support_decomposition.augmented_gap: augmented-Z gap on rows retained by augmented-Z (informative Z_aug strata)
common_support_decomposition.primary_common_support_gap: primary-Z gap computed on EXACTLY the augmented-Z common-support rows
common_support_decomposition.common_support_row_set: evaluator valid rows intersect informative Z_aug strata for that identity; no other set; no restored rows; never chosen using score values
common_support_decomposition.additive_identity: total_change == composition_change + conditioning_change, verified for all 24 cells to 1e-9
common_support_decomposition.empty_common_support: augmented_gap and primary_common_support_gap null, identity check skipped, cell flagged; never imputed

interpretation_commitment.composition_dominates: describe as primarily due to altered retained support/composition, NOT as length conditioning explaining the association
interpretation_commitment.conditioning_dominates: describe as primarily associated with additional conditioning on length
interpretation_commitment.gap_increase: use same decomposition to distinguish composition-driven vs conditioning-driven amplification
interpretation_commitment.no_causal_language: no 'length causes' or 'length mediates'; strongest wording: additional conditioning on length changes/attenuates/amplifies the residual association on the common support

prediction.text: Adding a binary comment-length stratum to the exact seven-label human annotation vector will leave the Civil Comments LLM conditional gaps largely intact. Among cells with primary |D| >= 0.05, we predict the median absolute relative change in D will be below 15%. Absolute gap changes will be reported for all 24 cells regardless of primary effect size.
prediction.evaluated_on: median absolute relative change among cells with primary |gap| >= 0.05, on total change
prediction.decomposition_role: diagnoses WHY total change occurred; NOT used to redefine whether the prediction passed

summary: full decomposition of largest abs total change cell

execution_order: commit+push this spec and the analysis script BEFORE computing; then run analysis; freeze/hash/commit results; STOP before manuscript editing or any Gemini missingness bound
